descriptionNullable: Longer training of the spectrum-candidate model of Saner Turhaner (sanpier/casmi-spectrum-model-v1): the published architecture, features, preprocessing and training code are used unchanged (model.py, features.py, config.json, inference.py, train.py, prepare.py, environment.json are byte-identical copies, see SHA256SUMS.txt); only the training length changed (40 epochs x 2,000 steps with patience 5 instead of 16 x 500), followed by the published full-data refit. Training cache: public notebook ahmedberatozer/casmi26-neural-long-prep (sanpier's prepare.py on the competition train.parquet). Training script: kaggle/colab_neural/neural_long_train.py in this dataset's README. Drop-in for notebooks that load sanpier's bundle (same config.json, model.py, features.py; only final_model.pt differs). Source note: trained on the Enveda CASMI26 competition training data (CC BY-NC 4.0 components); use under the source licenses (non-commercial, with attribution). Architecture and code: sanpier. Training run: ahmedberatozer.
